{"contents": "import dpkt, re
from socket import inet_ntoa
from collections import defaultdict
f=open('cap.pcap','rb')
r=dpkt.pcap.Reader(f)
streams=defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(bytes))
order=[]
for ts,buf in r:
    eth=dpkt.ethernet.Ethernet(buf)
    ip=eth.data
    tcp=ip.data
    key=(inet_ntoa(ip.src), tcp.sport, inet_ntoa(ip.dst), tcp.dport)
    if key not in order: order.append(key)
    payload=bytes(tcp.payload)
    if payload:
        streams[key][ts]+=payload
out=open('reqs.txt','w')
cnt=0
for key in order:
    if key[3]!=8080: continue
    data=b''.join(streams[key][ts] for ts in sorted(streams[key]))
    txt=data.decode('latin-1')
    cnt+=1
    out.write("="*60+"\n")
    out.write(txt+"\n")
out.close()
print("client->server streams:", cnt)
", "path": "ctf_files/an2.py"}
